name: demo-selenium-rust
summary: A small Rust walkthrough demo that uses the thirtyfour crate to connect to a WebDriver server, navigate to testingexamples.github.io, and demonstrate locator strategies and form interactions.
description: Demonstration of Selenium browser automation using Rust and the thirtyfour crate, connecting to a WebDriver server (e.g. chromedriver) to navigate to https://testingexamples.github.io/en-001/practice/ and demonstrate locating elements by id, name, class, link text, and XPath, then filling a text input, checking a checkbox, checking a radio button, and selecting an option in a select element.
